title: fix(core, console): the offboarding hand-over's owner follows each object's Change Owner switch
body:
Fixes #35399

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/` teaches the object switch `userActions.transfer` or the offboarding hand-over (`git grep -i 'userActions\|change owner\|assigned-work' -- skills` on the branch head hits only list-view and interface `userActions`, a different key)

## 维护者速读

- 管理员封禁用户并交接其记录时：对象关闭了“更改负责人”，该对象记录的负责人就不再交接；明细对象默认不交接，作者打开开关后照常交接。不交接的记录仍计数，弹窗写明“该对象保持负责人不变”，不再误说“该字段可填多人”。
- 属于“记录负责人变更与离职交接”专题：离职交接与“更改负责人”按同一个开关判定。
- 若判错，会多交接或少交接某对象的负责人，其他用户字段不受影响；可撤回：作者改开关即可，已交接的记录可再用“更改负责人”改回。
- 无

## What changes

- **One rule for both doors.** `userAssignedWorkFields` (`packages/core/src/security/user-assigned-work.ts`) no longer carries its own `controlled_by_parent` reading (`accessFollowsMaster` is gone). An `owner_id` that is the platform's reassignable owner (`isTransferEligible`) follows `resolveUserActionTransfer` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, the resolution `changeOwnerOffReason` refuses Change Owner by. Off by the derived default on a detail, on otherwise, author-overridable both ways.
- **Counted, not moved, with a reason.** A switched-off owner is no longer left out. Its row is counted with `transferable: false` and `reason: 'transfer_off'`. A multi-valued field's row now says `reason: 'multi_valued'`. `transferUserAssignedWork` moves only `transferable` rows, so `remaining` counts only what another call could move. New exported type `UserAssignedWorkHoldReason` (`@objectstack/core`). The client's `UserAssignedWorkSummary` row gains the optional `reason` member.
- **App-authored user fields are unchanged.** An approver or assignee is handed over whatever the switch says. An `owner_id` on an object the platform gives no owner (`systemFields: false`) is app-authored too.
- **Optional-master corner (scope note 2): follows the switch as is.** On a switched-off detail with `required: false` master, a null-master row keeps its owner. The docblock and the admin guide say how a Modify All holder moves it by hand.
- **The panel words a row by why it stays.** `UserAssignedWorkPanel` picks `console.assignedWork.ownerKept` for `transfer_off`. Only a multi-valued row keeps `notTransferable`. The new key is in all 11 UI locales: ten are hand-translated, and zh-Hant is generated from zh-Hans (`gen:zh-hant`). The existing `notTransferable` text was already the multi-valued sentence and is unchanged.
- **Stale prose rewritten** (scope notes 2, N2, and 3): the `user-assigned-work.ts` docblock lead sentence (rewritten per object), `security.assignedWork.count` in `packages/client/src/index.ts`, `registerUserWorkEndpoints` in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, the admin guide's hand-over section (which this change made false), and the Change Owner paragraph of the data API page.
- **N4 (scope note 7069035638):** a dogfood case for `assertAssignableUser` on the real showcase, through the Change Owner door that shares it. A new owner who exists but sits outside the caller's organization (the caller's own `GET /data/sys_user/:id` answers 404, as armed) gets the same answer as an id that exists nowhere: status, code, field, and message apart from the id. The owner stays.

File surface beyond the claim's list, declared: `packages/core/src/security/index.ts` (the type export), `content/docs/permissions/administrator-guide.mdx` and `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` (prose this change made false or incomplete). The dogfood case went into the existing Change Owner dogfood file, not a new one.

## Tests

All runs at head `a31b2c96` unless named (the core, client and dogfood runs were at `21720ae6` and `285d2848`. The later commits touch only `ui/` test files, the generated zh-Hant pack and docs).

- `@objectstack/core`, whole package: `Test Files 156 passed (156)`, `Tests 3740 passed (3740)`. The `[#35399]` describe has 11 cases: switch on (bare and object form), switch off (bare and object form), derived default on a detail, the twin under every other sharing model, an app-authored `owner_id` on a `systemFields: false` object, a parity pin of the roster against `resolveUserActionTransfer` and `changeOwnerOffReason` over 9 definitions, count, transfer (with no read or write naming the detail's owner), and the optional-master null-master row. The #35344 interim pin (left out of the roster) is subsumed: the same fixtures now pin counted-not-moved, as the describe's lead comment says.
- `@objectstack/client`, whole package: `Test Files 59 passed (59)`, `Tests 820 passed (820)`.
- `@objectstack/rest`: `src/user-work-routes.test.ts` 7/7 (only a comment changed in `rest-server.ts`).
- Typecheck: `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/rest` `typecheck` exit 0 (core's runs its test-layer gate too), and `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` exit 0 (src and `tsconfig.test.json`), after building its dependency closure.
- Dogfood, `test/change-owner-endpoint.dogfood.test.ts` on the real showcase: `Tests 7 passed (7)`, including the new N4 case.
- UI: `ActionParamDialog.banAssignedWork-30205.test.tsx` 16/16 (two new `objectstack#35399` cases). `ui/packages/i18n/` whole package (`--maxWorkers=1`): `Test Files 108 passed (108)`, `Tests 2011 passed / 13 skipped`.
- The i18n run first went red, and both causes are fixed in this PR. zh-Hant is generated, so it is now regenerated from zh-Hans with `gen:zh-hant` instead of hand-written. The de paired-quote pin moves 134 to 135, with its note, for the one new de pair.
- **Declared narrowing:** `@object-ui/app-shell`'s whole package (2476 test files) was not run locally. One `--maxWorkers=2` attempt was stopped by its recorded PID after about 30 minutes on this shared box. CI's sharded `Test UI` runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- **The nested `security.sharingModel` spot is no longer read by the hand-over.** The removed `accessFollowsMaster` read `sharingModel ?? security.sharingModel`, as the access gates do. The spec's switch default (`derivedTransferDefault`) reads only the declared top-level `sharingModel`, and `security` is not an `ObjectSchema` key. So a raw-registered object that spells its detail model only in the nested spot now hands its owner over, and Change Owner already offered the action on it. The two doors agree, and a parity pin covers this shape. `git grep` finds no producer that writes `security: { sharingModel }` outside tests on this tree, so no card is filed. If the nested spot should count, the fix is one line in the spec's `derivedTransferDefault`, and both doors follow it.
- **Spec prose for the switch** (`transfer`'s `.describe` in `object.zod.ts`, the `user-action-transfer.ts` docblock) still names only the Change Owner action. Neither statement is false (the switch still does not gate a plain `owner_id` write). Adding "and the offboarding hand-over" is a `packages/spec` `.describe` edit with `gen:schema && gen:docs`, outside this claim's file surface, so it is left for the seat to route.
- Behaviour change for authors, named in the changeset: an object with `userActions.transfer: false` used to have its owners handed over and now keeps them. A detail with `userActions.transfer: true` used to keep its owner and now hands it over.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/core/src/security/user-assigned-work.ts`: `ownerTransferOff` and the roster loop (the only rule change).
2. `packages/core/src/security/user-assigned-work.test.ts`: the `[#35399]` describe, especially the parity pin against `resolveUserActionTransfer` and `changeOwnerOffReason`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/UserAssignedWorkPanel.tsx`: `notTransferableKey`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/security/user-assigned-work.test.ts` shows every `[#35399]` case green. In the console, ban a user who owns an invoice line on the showcase: the line's row says it is not handed over because the object keeps its owner, and the hand-over leaves it.

<details><summary>Local gates (dispatch-gates --ran: 110 derived, 106 run, 4 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN)</summary>

- 106 derived families exit 0. `pnpm check:test-source-alias` went red once, on this PR's own test, which loaded the locale packs inside a test body. That load moved to module top, and the gate is green at `a31b2c96`. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` was SIGKILLed once under memory pressure. Re-run alone at `a31b2c96`, it gave `Test Files 172 passed / 2 skipped`.
- NOT MEASURED, exit 3 (the gate refused its own prerequisite): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone), `spec check:skill-examples` (no built client-react), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a whole-tree build), `check:type-check-debt` (re-measure prerequisite). CI runs all four.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0 at `a31b2c96`.
</details>
